header: POST /api/dev/console { entries: [{ t, l, p, m }] } DEVELOPMENT ONLY (404 in production). This writes the browser's console to `.browser-console.log` in the project folder (see src/lib/dev/consoleBridge.ts). It starts afresh when the dev server starts: the first write of a server process empties the file.

symbols.name: g
symbols.sig: const g = globalThis as unknown as { __dspBrowserLogStarted?: boolean }
doc: I keep this on globalThis: a hot reload of this file must not empty the log in the middle of a session.
